verdict.line: You lose if you let Gangplank farm you down with free Parrrley resets while you have no answer at range; you win if you close the gap while his Remove Scurvy is down and force a stun-into-R chain he can't cleanse.

brief.thesis: Gangplank fights this lane from range with Q (Parrrley, 5s cooldown, 625 range) stacking his passive Grog-Soaked Blade poison, while Sett has zero ranged pressure and only one real gap-closer: E (Facebreaker, 490 range) which only stuns if Gangplank is sandwiched between Sett and something else — against a lone Gangplank it just slows. The 49.8% win rate over 2396 games reflects a lane that's decided by who controls engagement range, not raw stats, which is also why Sett holds the solo-kill edge once he's actually in Gangplank's face.

theirWindow.when: Q up and you're near the wave
theirWindow.what: He will poke you off CS for free since his 625 range outranges your entire kit at neutral spacing. Either eat the poke while banking Haymaker Grit, or hold off the wave until you can close distance under Q's move-speed buff from Knuckle Down.

yourWindow.when: his W (Remove Scurvy, 18-22s CD) is down
yourWindow.what: Remove Scurvy clears any CC on him, so landing E or R while it's up just gets cleansed. When it's on cooldown, dive with E (even the slow version closes range) and chain straight into R (The Show Stopper) — he has no way to cleanse the slam or the landing slow.

start.why: Carries the higher measured win rate (52.3% over 1350 games) and backs the aggressive, autoattack-trading plan this lane needs over the purely defensive Doran's Shield line.

boots.why: Most-picked option (65.3% pick, 48.9% WR) and directly cuts the autoattack/poison harass from Grog-Soaked Blade and his Parrrley follow-up autos.

core.why: Gives the gap-close and burst needed to actually catch a kiting Gangplank — the backbone of the 55.4% WR build path.
Sustained damage for extended trades once you're already on top of him, and the most popular follow-up (24.3% pick).
Stacks health that feeds both Pit Grit's regen and Haymaker's stored Grit shield, rewarding the tank-and-punch pattern you're forced into.

he's building toward poke-and-kite team comps and you need raw HP to out-sustain the chip damage

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the sustained melee trading this matchup forces on you, and ramps healing that pairs with Pit Grit's missing-health regen during extended skirmishes.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the dominant pick at 80.5% with a 50.9% win rate, and Ignite converts your measured solo-kill advantage into actual kills once you close distance and land E.

playing.title: Track Parrrley, not just position
playing.detail: His 5-second Q cooldown is the real clock on this lane. When it's down, he has no way to punish you for stepping up to trade or contest CS.

playing.title: Bank Grit before cashing Haymaker
playing.detail: W passively stores damage you take as Grit and only pays off on cast. Don't W the instant you're poked — let a couple of Parrrleys stack into it so the shield and true-damage punch actually matter.

playing.title: E alone only slows a lone target
playing.detail: Facebreaker stuns only when he's pinned between you and something else on the opposite side; against a solo Gangplank it's just a slow. Use that slow to close distance into R, not as a standalone stun.

playing.title: Hold R until his W is down
playing.detail: Remove Scurvy clears CC and heals him — using The Show Stopper into an available Remove Scurvy wastes your 80-120s cooldown. Bait it out or wait for it to be on cooldown first.

playing.title: Freeze the wave near your tower
playing.detail: Forcing him to walk up for CS is where your solo-kill edge shows up — he has to enter your effective range to last-hit, and that's when Q's move-speed-toward-champions actually lets you catch him.

playing.title: Don't contest early all-in windows
playing.detail: Levels 1-2 are his best trading window thanks to free Parrrley poke with no reply from you. Play for CS and patience until E comes online at level 3.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, summoner, and win-rate numbers above are pulled from measured games on the current patch; the cooldown reads, trade-window timing, and overall tactical plan are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Do not get hit by Gangplank’s Grasp of the Undying – (Q) combo. Use [E] when his (W) is on cooldown to follow up with [R] when dealing damage.
